about_page_subtitle: Your passion for figurines, our mission
our_mission_text: FiguVerse was born from a passion for the world of collectible figurines. Our mission is to create the largest French-speaking community dedicated to anime, manga and video game figurines, offering a space for sharing, discovery and exchange for all collectors.
our_story_text: Created in 2023 by figurine enthusiasts, FiguVerse quickly evolved from a simple personal blog to a complete platform. We started by sharing our own collections and reviews, then developed partnerships with major manufacturers and distributors to bring you the latest information.
team_founder_bio: Collector for 15 years, specialized in shonen and Japanese RPG figurines.
team_manager_bio: Community management and event hosting. Passionate about magical girls.
team_reviewer_bio: Expert in figurine quality and new releases. Mecha and sci-fi specialist.
value_passion_text: We share your love for figurines and the universe of Japanese pop culture.
value_community_text: Creating connections between collectors and fostering enriching exchanges.
value_quality_text: Providing reliable information, in-depth tests and informed advice.
value_accessibility_text: Making collecting accessible to everyone, beginners and experts alike.
guide_subtitle: Everything you need to know to start your figurine collection
guide_intro: Discovering the world of collectible figurines? This guide will accompany you in your first steps to understand the different types, materials, scales and best practices.
scale_figures_desc: High-end figurines with exceptional detail, usually between 1/4 and 1/8 scale.
prize_figures_desc: Quality figurines at affordable prices, often from Japanese crane machines.
nendoroid_desc: Articulated chibi figurines with interchangeable accessories from Good Smile Company.
figma_desc: Highly articulated figurines allowing numerous dynamic poses.
pvc_desc: Most common material, flexible and durable. Easy to maintain.
resin_desc: High-end material allowing fine details but more fragile.
abs_desc: Hard plastic used for joints and moving parts.
scale_1_6_desc: Perfect balance between detail and display size.
scale_1_7_desc: Most popular scale, ideal for beginners.
scale_1_8_desc: Compact format, perfect for large collections.
dusting_tip: Use a soft brush or antistatic duster. Avoid water on painted parts.
storage_tip: Store in a dry place, away from direct light and extreme temperatures.
display_tip: Use display cases to protect from dust and UV. Avoid humid areas.
cleaning_tip: For deep cleaning, disassemble if possible and use warm water with mild soap.
garage_kit_def: Resin figurine to assemble and paint yourself.
prepainted_def: Figurine already painted and assembled, ready to display.
exclusive_def: Limited edition figurine, often tied to an event.
bootleg_def: Counterfeit figurine, usually of inferior quality.
grail_def: Highly sought-after and hard-to-find figurine, often expensive.
